schema_documentation:
Flat JSON object, 8 keys (9 in 73 records). No nesting anywhere, no JSON-encoded-string fields.

| key | type | presence | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | str | 100% | Official OJ title — **English**. 0/3000 sampled titles had >30% Greek chars. |
| `document_url` | str | 100% | EUR-Lex AUTO URL with `uri=CELEX:...&qid=...&rid=...`; qid/rid are crawl-session artifacts |
| `el_html_link` | str | 100% | Greek HTML EUR-Lex URL, same CELEX |
| `category_id` | str | 100% | `search_NN`; 25 distinct values over the full file, incl. 6 malformed (search_0860, search_0930, search_093020, search_116040, search_1330, search_1720) |
| `category_title` | str | 100% | **English** subject label, e.g. `(03 Agriculture, number of acts: 4111)` |
| `category_acts_count` | **str** | 100% | site-level act total for the category, NOT records in file (README says int — wrong, it is a string) |
| `row_index` | int | 100% | 0–22,766 |
| `text` | str \| null | 100% | Greek legislative body as Markdown. null in 73 records (0.32%) |
| `body_missing` | bool | 0.32% (73 records, grep-exact) | present iff `text` is null |
semantic_meaning: EU Official Journal legislation, Greek language versions, one act per record, HTML converted to Markdown.
